@everyone


Tier 4 Copi FILE NODE SALE (Cardano) opens Tomorrow!
,
Get prepared for Tier 4 of the Node sale Tomorrow (Tuesday the 2nd of January) at 8pm UTC.
If you do not have your account set up on cornucopias.io please do so now, by following the instructions in this Major Announcement: ⁠⁠⁠💰│announcements⁠

We will take a snapshot of the ADA price one hour prior to the sale and post the number of ADA that equals $315 USD. You'll need this amount in your wallet plus a minimum of 10 ADA extra for fees and such.

Wallet Hygiene: We are stressing this to prevent payment issues!
Please follow these guidelines below to avoide possible transaction problems...

Please avoid using Typhoon as it was the source of many failed transactions in the past tiers.
If you have more than a couple NFTs in your wallet or you anticipate using your wallet prior to the sale, please visit https://unfrack.it/ which is a wonderful tool made by our partners at DripDropz. It cleans up the fragmentation that occurs in Wallets with many transactions.

Be ready to enter the Sale at  8pm UTC. 

Tier 4 will remain open until it is sold out!

ETH Tiers will be available soon. We will announce details when we have them.

@everyone


Get prepared for Tier 4 File Node sale today at 20:00 UTC.
,
(in just under an hour)

Next make sure to have 515 ADA (plus a minimum of 10 ADA extra for fees and such) in your wallet.
ADA was $0.612 USD at 19:00 UTC today on Coinbase.

Wallet Hygiene: 
It is a good idea to manually Re-Sync your wallet. All wallet apps have some way to manually sync the wallet. If you are unsure how to do that, ask.
We advise that you use a fresh wallet to make your purchases.

Be ready to enter the Sale at 20:00 UTC. 

You may purchase 10 Nodes in this Tier. ONE per transaction. You will need to do 10 individual transactions if you are minting 10 Nodes!

@everyone 
If you are intending to buy more than one NODE in this Tier, 


BEFORE you click the Enter Again Button
,
Please wait until you see that Shipping has been initiated on your current order
,
